requirements.desc: The runtime-log command must accept `--expect-run-id`, `--expect-issue`, and `--expect-spec` using the existing target-aware types and validation, require at least one of them, and accept every non-empty subset.
requirements.note: R1: requires a non-empty subset of the shared target expectations

requirements.desc: The command must resolve exactly one local, active, or preparing target from the supplied identity; every supplied expectation must match, and missing, ambiguous, or mismatched input must not fall back to another flow.
requirements.note: R2: isolates exact active and preparing targets when several flows exist

requirements.desc: Run ID, Issue, and spec mismatches against a resolved target must return `ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH` with the existing expected/active identity data and no runtime-log content.
requirements.note: R3: reports each local target identity mismatch without log content

requirements.desc: A missing or ambiguous explicit target must return a structured `FLOW_TARGET_NOT_FOUND` failure, and a target with no matching log block must return the existing `RUNTIME_LOG_NOT_FOUND` failure; neither failure may disclose another target's log.
requirements.note: R4: distinguishes missing target from missing runtime log without fallback

requirements.desc: After a target match, raw text, `--format json`, `--sequence`, `--run-id`, `runId#sequence`, conflict validation, latest non-runtime-log selection, and existing invalid-argument envelopes must retain their public behavior while selecting only blocks owned by the resolved target run ID.
requirements.note: R5: preserves raw, JSON, and block-selector contracts after target match

requirements.desc: Successful and failed runtime-log reads must not modify flow files, spec files, runtime-log content, metadata, Issue state, board state, or generated product artifacts beyond the dispatcher's established command-log append.
requirements.note: R6: leaves flow and runtime-log files unchanged on success and mismatch

requirements.desc: All other `flow get` subcommands must retain their existing options, target resolution, output envelopes, and mutation behavior.
requirements.note: R7: confines target-option behavior to runtime-log while every other get contract keeps regression coverage
